name: Super Tokkiui Moheom
source:
『Super Bunny's Adventure』 is a text adventure where you experience a special daily life with Super Bunny, whose wish is to go to the moon, and a strange Bunny Girl who wears bunny girl outfits in everyday life.

Join Super Bunny, who struggles even to make eye contact and is clumsy in every aspect of daily life, and experience the shocking conclusion of their journey.

Will the story end with a happy ending? Find out for yourself.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3357470/]Steam[/url]]
